title: InsightTrack Analyst Bench
subtitle: 480 cases testing LLMs as the AI analyst in a web analytics product
description:
**Which LLM should power the AI analyst inside a real analytics product?** This dataset holds
the cases, sample tables and graders for **InsightTrack Analyst Bench**, a Kaggle benchmark that gives models
the job of *Pulse*, the AI analyst in [InsightTrack](https://github.com/NishikantaRay/InsightTrack), an
open-source web analytics platform.

### Four task groups, 480 cases

| Group | The model gets | Graded on |
|---|---|---|
| Tool choice (120) | A user question and the real 23-tool Pulse catalogue | Right tool and arguments, or "none" |
| Data reading (120) | A real-shaped tool result and a question | The number or path; "not_available" when the data lacks it |
| Diagnosis (120) | Weekly traffic plus Google results before and after | Real change or noise, direction, and the exact causes |
| SQL (120) | The DuckDB events/sessions tables and a question | The query's result, run read-only |

Each group has **80 standard + 40 hard** cases. Graders also label *how* a model fails: invented causes,
made-up numbers, tools that don't exist, noise called real (or the reverse).

### How the answers are known
- **Diagnosis:** a Python port of InsightTrack's `correlationService.js`, checked against the original JavaScript on every case and 1,500 random ones.
- **SQL:** each reference query is run on the shipped tables.
- **Data reading:** computed from the same data the model sees.
- **Tool choice:** each question names the tool(s) that answer it; both are accepted when two are defensible.

### Notes
- All data is **synthetic**; no real site's visitors are included.
- Everything is seeded and rebuilds byte-for-byte.
- Built for the DEV x Kaggle Benchmarking Challenge.
- Source, tests and docs: the `kaggle-bench` project alongside InsightTrack.
userSpecifiedSources: Synthetic, generated by the InsightTrack Analyst Bench builder. Diagnosis rules ported from InsightTrack's correlationService.js; tool catalogue and table layouts from [InsightTrack](https://github.com/NishikantaRay/InsightTrack).

resources.description: Group 1: a user question; the model must pick the right InsightTrack tool and arguments, or "none". 120 cases (80 standard, 40 hard).
Group 2: a tool result in InsightTrack's real output format plus a question; 39 of 120 cannot be answered from the data.
Group 3: weekly page traffic plus Google results before and after; is the change real, and what caused it? Gold answers come from InsightTrack's own correlation rules.
Group 4: a question over the events/sessions tables with a reference query and its result. Model SQL is executed and graded on its output.
Synthetic tracking events (pageviews and custom events), July-August 2026, in InsightTrack's DuckDB `events` layout.
